metric_defs.hit_at_k: single gold => contained in top-K; multi-hop => BOTH gold contained
metric_defs.mrr: single => 1/rank of gold; multi-hop => mean of the two golds' reciprocal ranks
metric_defs.answer_span_recall_at_k: fraction of evidence snippets found in top-K passage text (text-based, KG-independent)
metric_defs.bridge_coverage_at_k: multi-hop only: 1 iff both gold papers in top-K
